title: Urinalysis Results in Healthy Individuals
brief_summary: This is a prospective, observational study assessing the results of urine dipsticks on adult volunteers with no acute symptoms. We seek to determine the frequency of leukocytes or nitrites in this group of individuals.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years
* Able to spontaneously provide a urine sample

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any acute symptoms (including but not limited to vaginal bleeding, vaginal discharge, abdominal pain, back pain, dysuria, hematuria, and fever)
* Pregnancy
* Prisoner status
* Antibiotics within 72 hours
* Urologic procedure within a week
study_population: Subjects are all healthy volunteers, who are primarily family, friends, or acquaintances of study investigators.
